card.name: First letter starting a new drug-interaction entry
card.fires_on: A capital letter or one-letter piece that begins a new drug name or heading, right after a list break or heading with no space, as in a drug-interaction section. Often the S or R of the next entry, or the S after Non- or Cross-.

modes.label: After Non- or Cross-
modes.description: The S after a hyphen in Non-Steroidal or Cross-Sensitivity.

modes.label: Start of next entry
modes.description: A first letter of a new drug or warning glued to the end of the previous entry.

card.writes: No clear meaning; the promoted tokens are mixed multilingual pieces, so it adds little readable output.
card.plain: It fires on the first letter of a new drug name or heading that runs straight on from the previous entry.
